narrative.summary: Read again on 2026-10-31 (Arbitrum block 520043942, two RPCs). The 2026-09-19 correction named a bare EOA among the holders of TIMELOCK_ADMIN on the RoleStore: that is no longer so, the role is held by two Safes (5-of-8 and 4-of-6). The same bare EOA still holds PROPOSER, EXECUTOR and CANCELLER on the two ConfigTimelockControllers that are ROLE_ADMIN holders of the RoleStore, and a simulated schedule of a RoleStore ROLE_ADMIN grant from that address is accepted at the 24h minimum delay (refused at zero delay and from a random address). The 5-of-8 Safe holds the same roles there and can cancel inside the 24h window.
narrative.tag: one key can still start the 24h clock (read 2026-10-31)
narrative.detail: Dated read, block 520043942 (2026-10-31 16:48 UTC), two RPCs. (1) RoleStore TIMELOCK_ADMIN: the 5-of-8 Safe 0x8D1d2e24… and the 4-of-6 Safe 0x58F58245…; the EOA 0xE014cbD6… listed on 2026-09-19 is not a member. The RoleStore emits no events, so the date of that change cannot be read. (2) ROLE_ADMIN holders: five, the GMX DAO timelock, two ConfigTimelockControllers (0x2Dd99f39…, 0xF68560cA…) and two TimelockConfig contracts (0xE7706986…, 0x4Ed34E6c…), all Sourcify-verified, every controller with getMinDelay 86400. The second pair is the migration the 2026-09-19 audit noted as not yet live: its roles on the controller were set up on 2026-10-22, and the date it became ROLE_ADMIN is not readable. In the verified source neither TimelockConfig has a function that grants a role directly or schedules with less than the controller minimum delay; revokeRole is immediate for the TIMELOCK_MULTISIG Safe only. (3) On both controllers the EOA 0xE014cbD6… (no code, nonce 72, the same as on 2026-09-19) holds PROPOSER, EXECUTOR and CANCELLER (hasRole read), as do both Safes and the TimelockConfig of that pair. A schedule of a ROLE_ADMIN grant, simulated by eth_call from the EOA, is accepted at 86400 seconds and refused at 0; from a random address it is refused. (4) The GMX DAO timelock: the second bare EOA noted on 2026-09-20 (0xE7BfFf2a…) had PROPOSER, EXECUTOR and CANCELLER revoked on 2026-10-24 (blocks 517982783 to 517982861); the remaining holder is a contract (0x03e8f708…). Not verified: that the EOA could execute a scheduled grant (EXECUTOR is read, only the scheduling was simulated), who controls that key, whether the Safe signers watch the queue, and whether any path other than these roles leads to a RoleStore grant. The earlier findings are kept, with a dated update, in chains/arbitrum-ecosystem/data/rotation_audit_2026-09-19-index0-gmx-rolestore.md. The score published for this target does not yet take the controller roles above into account; do not rely on it until the scoring method is corrected.
